d: Two identical figures with a young, childlike maturity and a petite build. They have honey-blonde hair styled in high side-ponytails tied with orange ribbons, featuring curly bangs and loose tendrils framing the face. Their eyes are a pale lime green with a gentle, smiling expression. Each wears a short-sleeved orange and brown striped shirt under oversized dark indigo denim overalls with white lace trim on the chest pocket and hips, paired with dusty rose sneakers. A small, colorful floral ornament made of red, yellow, green, and blue spheres is attached to the waist of the overalls.
